# Experience

## Research intern — Peking University Health Science Center

05/2023 - 08/2023

- Screening Study for Senile Alzheimer's Disease: Collecting gait videos and MoCA cognitive scores from over 200 community-dwelling elderly individuals, extracting gait temporal characteristics, constructing a machine learning model, and quantifying the correlation between gait indicators and cognitive impairment;
- Systematic Review and Meta-analysis: Independently completing literature screening and JBI methodological quality evaluation, relying on GRADE to complete evidence grading; Using Stata 17.0 to combine OR/RR/HR and 95% confidence intervals, selecting fixed/random effect models based on heterogeneity, and conducting subgroup analysis and one-by-one elimination sensitivity analysis

## Research intern - China National Health Development Research Center

07/2026 - 08/2026

- Health economic assessment of coronary heart disease: Based on the Markov decision model, calculating the long-term cost-effectiveness ratio and net monetary gain of PCI, CABG, and intensive lipid-lowering regimens, providing quantitative evidence for the intervention standards of secondary prevention for coronary heart disease;
- Large-sample Meta-integration study: Integrating clinical data of 122,485 patients with coronary heart disease, conducting stratified analysis of treatment benefits differences in high-infarction and high-blooding-risk populations, identifying differentiated intervention targets;
- Medical AI policy assessment: Constructing a six-dimensional multi-criteria scoring model, horizontally comparing the adaptability of medical AI pilot projects in 6 cities, outputting quantitative radar charts and comprehensive ranking reports, supporting the formulation of health digitalization policies.
